name: Jogging

instructions.description: Begin with a short warm-up walk and then transition into an easy running pace.
Keep your posture tall with a slight forward lean from the ankles rather than the waist.
Land softly under your center of mass and keep your arm swing relaxed.
Slow to a walk for a gradual cool-down at the end of the session.

performanceMetrics.notes: Adjust pace to match the planned training zone.

variations.variationDescription: Higher impact and higher-intensity progression from brisk walking.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Alternate short jogging bouts with walking recovery.

commentsNotes: Increase volume gradually if you are new to running.
